text: God's Message to the prophet Jeremiah regarding the Philistines just before Pharaoh attacked Gaza.

"Look out! Water will rise in the north country, swelling like a river in flood. The torrent will flood the land, washing away city and citizen. Men and women will scream in terror, wails from every door and window,
the clatter of chariots, the banging of wheels. Fathers, paralyzed by fear, won't even grab up their babies
no hope of help for Tyre and Sidon. God will finish off the Philistines, what's left of those from the island of Crete.
Ashkelon struck dumb as a post. You're on your last legs. How long will you keep flailing?
how long will you keep this up? Return to your scabbard. Haven't you had enough? Can't you call it quits?
when I, God, command the action? I've ordered it to cut down Ashkelon and the seacoast."
